coverage.scope: historical_stage2b_cache_only; completed new experiment is in new_matched_run

decision: Positive bounded video-ranking signal: native3 cleanly promotes p0_q23 and p3_q34 versus both controls and original baseline, with no observed video regression. Localization and temporal-order causality remain unestablished.

decision_gate.candidate_limitations: Six of eight accepted videos are absent from top3; zero of 31 target events occur in the exact sampled frames. Native3 reaches the 2/8 video ceiling.
decision_gate.next_step_limit: Do not expand N after observing these outcomes. Packet E may propose a separately frozen candidate-pool experiment; no automatic video encoder or native5 run.
decision_gate.qualification: Meaningful ranking gains satisfy A5; this label is restricted to video ranking. It does not assert learned temporal-order use or event localization.

full_matched_runtime_context.evidence: Parent execution lead observed A and B Actions jobs start one second apart on pooled Windows listeners.
full_matched_runtime_context.full_matched_run_latency_context: Observed host timings with possible concurrent load from Packet B; not an isolated microbenchmark.
full_matched_runtime_context.quality_comparison_note: The possible overlap does not change candidate, model, or paired input definitions; any resource failure must still fail the completion gate.

manifest_reconciliation.completed_count_scope: all cached rows across modes and queries; not current request or eight-query count
manifest_reconciliation.resolution: One-candidate encode completed; launcher manifest was not updated. Raw files are preserved.

model.historical_query_instruction: Retrieve images or text relevant to the user's query.

timestamp_provenance.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 8.1.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
timestamp_provenance.method: Decode original stream from start, select exact zero-based n values, showinfo PTS; map selected chronological output to sorted requested frame IDs.
timestamp_provenance.note: Source timestamps are display/provenance only; frozen P3 scoring retains its original 50-frame tolerance.

candidate_pool_ceiling.scoring_unit: Exact sampled frame IDs, not all intervening frames in the temporal interval.

limits: Eight selected development queries; no generalization claim.
R@5/R@20 over the same three candidates cannot show reranking recall gains.
Frozen event/localization truth includes submission-derived proxies and provisional P3 targets.
Center-only and equal-window localization are separate; each arm receives the same scoring opportunity.

timing.causal_runtime_diagnosis: not_measured; CPU BF16 and larger native image/token input are hypotheses

current_float32_matched_smoke.causal_limit: Dtype and input resolution changed jointly; runtime cannot be attributed to either alone.
current_float32_matched_smoke.comparability: changes dtype and input resolution; timing-only, cannot resume old cache

native3.estimate_method: linear extrapolation from the observed candidates; not a measured sweep
